label: CAUSE_3, in Aristotle's four modes: Whatever stands as a CAUSE_3 of an effect does so in at least…
definition: Whatever stands as a cause of an effect does so in at least one of four modes: matter, form, mover (source of change) and end (Physics II.3, 194b16-195a3). The modes are relations between cause and effect, not labels on objects.
note: Declaration completion, attribution deferred: FourCauseModes is a type of interpretations carrying Cause and Effect carrier parameters, IsCause and the four binary mode relations, constrained by the unchanged TruthCore.Greek.Aristotle.Physics.FourCauseExhaustiveReading. It preserves one-way at-least-one coverage, permits overlapping modes and makes no converse claim. The relations remain explicit primitives, not completed definitions of matter, form, change or end. Intended examples: bronze relative to a statue (material), its shape/account (formal), sculptor relative to its production (source of change), commemoration relative to its production (final); bronze need not be a source of change and sculptor need not be the material. These illustrative applications are not newly verified source claims. No transitivity, asymmetry, irreflexivity, temporal priority or well-foundedness is imposed; causes and effects may inhabit separate carriers. Agent-efficient accounts, regularity accounts and accounts rejecting final causation may interpret or reject these primitives differently. OPEN semantic obligations: supply faithful interpretations of each primitive and their recursive vocabulary, defend particular applications, and justify any generalization to reality. Root connection plan: test STMT-CAUSE-SENSES-EXHAUSTIVE against an explicit four-mode route interpretation, targeting STMT-NOTHING-IS-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-OF-ITSELF. Blocker: no supplied identification between these carriers/relations and CauseFrame.Being/Respect or its moving/efficient/perfection/origin branches. Such an identification must be an explicit open bridge, not definitional equality or a new constructor in the frozen coverage. No bridge or premise discharge is asserted by this declaration completion. Local semantic controls show failed coverage, overlap, and absence of a converse; these are not registered results.
